profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Playtomic
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with +7 years of experience as backend developer. I like to see that my day-by-day work and the decisions that I make impact both the company's goals and my teammate's professional growth; my commitment is to deliver scalable, maintainable software that fulfills business needs in the most optimal way.

In the last years, I have actively collaborated in the creation and maintenance of a microservices-based platform, with special emphasis on API design, data model definition, and the application of event-driven solutions for communication orchestration. I have also provided DevOps support to development teams and collaborated in the implementation and evolution of CD/CI pipelines.

I have also worked as team leader, collaborating with product managers in feature analysis and task refinement, coordinating and mentoring developer teammates for spreading software best practices, and balancing cost-benefit trade-offs while keeping aligned with the company's objectives. In that regard, I consider teamwork is an essential part of software development; I believe that participation in the creative process, through the contribution of ideas in the team, is the best strategy for delivering value.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend development in a web platform implemented over Symfony PHP framework. Analysis, design and implementation of new functionalities through microservices development, coded in Java using Spring framework, specifically Spring Boot technology, managed with maven and integrated with Docker in order to enable its execution in this kind of containers. Work in multidisciplinary teams with direct contact with customers in integration and systems migration projects.

Design patterns application during the process of software creation. Special experience in the development of Rest API used to improve the interoperability among components of the platform, and also, with external systems. Data model design and implementation in MySQL, using Hibernate and Spring JPA for its object mapping. Usage of Git version control system.

Agile methodologies usage as work process, specifically Scrum, using Jira as project management tool. Experience with various programming languages such as bash, javascript, html; technologies such as Wordpress, vaadin (fronted development), RabbitMQ (high-availability systems), elasticsearch (NoSQL data storage), among others.

positions.title: Software Architect fellow
positions.description: Participation in the SESAR Joint Undertaking (Single European Sky ATM Research) - Architectural design of Air Traffic Management Systems using the NATO Architectural Framework (NAF), using as modeling software tool Enterprise Architect for generating UML diagrams.

positions.title: Researcher fellow
positions.description: Development (Analysis, design and implementation) and maintenance of integrated applications running on Windows and Linux (OpenSUSE) Systems in different programming languages (C, C++, bash and python). Participation with INSA S.A. (Ingeniería y Servicios Aerospaciales) at the Cenit Project ATLANTIDA. Development of an automated system for generating meteorological predictions and tools for their visualization and distribution through the usage of WRF model.

courses.name: Free web development: Apache, PHP and MySQL (30 hours)
Wide-band access technologies at Telecommunication Networks (16 hours)
